failure_modes.mode: Credential controls remain exposed on ordinary settings visits
failure_modes.cause: Password inputs created in the main provider layout
failure_modes.detection: Browser asserts zero credential fields until dialog explicitly opened
failure_modes.mitigation: Status-only cards; provider-scoped dialog created on explicit click

failure_modes.mode: Entered secret remains in the DOM after dialog closes
failure_modes.cause: Hidden modal reused with uncleared input
failure_modes.detection: Close, Escape and successful-save browser checks
failure_modes.mitigation: Clear inputs and remove modal on every close; no reveal or existing-key representation

failure_modes.mode: Connection update discards pending route/budget changes
failure_modes.cause: Entire settings view rerendered after credential-only save
failure_modes.effect: Lost user edits or unintended combined save
failure_modes.detection: Intercept save payload and assert pending controls preserved
failure_modes.mitigation: Independent connection-only request and provider-card refresh

failure_modes.mode: Narrow layouts break or dialog controls become unreachable
failure_modes.cause: Dense grid/technical names and global dialog styles
failure_modes.detection: 375/768/1440 browser layouts, light/dark screenshots and keyboard tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Scoped responsive CSS, fixed pricing columns, bounded scrollable dialog and accessible labels

failure_modes.mode: Save changes effective routes without user editing them
failure_modes.cause: Default choices substitute missing/unsupported stored values
failure_modes.effect: Provider spend or request behavior changes
failure_modes.detection: Compare unchanged-save payload and effective models; fixture preservation
failure_modes.mitigation: Preserve effective values and legacy effort choices; no automatic provider switch
